targetTexts.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
targetTexts.2: “Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My food offerings, as a pleasing aroma to Me.
targetTexts.3: And tell them that this is the food offering you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
targetTexts.4: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
targetTexts.5: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
targetTexts.6: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
targetTexts.7: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.
targetTexts.8: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
targetTexts.9: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.
targetTexts.10: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
targetTexts.11: At the beginning of every month, you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
targetTexts.12: along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram,
targetTexts.13: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
targetTexts.14: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.
targetTexts.15: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
targetTexts.16: The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.
targetTexts.17: On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.
targetTexts.18: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
targetTexts.19: Present to the LORD a food offering, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.
targetTexts.20: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
targetTexts.21: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
targetTexts.22: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
targetTexts.23: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
targetTexts.24: Offer the same food each day for seven days as a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.
targetTexts.25: On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
targetTexts.26: On the day of firstfruits, when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
targetTexts.27: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old as a pleasing aroma to the LORD,
targetTexts.28: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
targetTexts.29: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
targetTexts.30: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
targetTexts.31: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. The animals must be unblemished.
